name: Izolda
description: Blood witch who leads the ritual to awaken Rakdos.

description_citations.text: "The Dissension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Decamillennial, Izolda uses dragon spinal fluid and the blood of Jarad and Myc to rouse Rakdos, who wreaks havoc until absorbed by Project Kraj.
timeline.quote: Rakdos awakened and wreaked havoc in the streets of Ravnica until the demon crossed the path of Project Kraj .

citation.text: "Cult of Rakdos", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sensing weakness after Rakdos's defeat, Izolda's followers devour her alive.
timeline.quote: Izolda's followers summarily devoured her alive.

citation.text: "Cult of Rakdos", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rakdos cultists waylay Fonn's training group; Jarad and Fonn accidentally bind Myc's mind to the demon.
timeline.quote: accidentally binding Myc's mind with the demon 's.

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Izolda sacrifices Jarad in a ritual to arouse Rakdos, but he survives by becoming a zombie/lich and keeps leadership.
timeline.quote: He was later sacrificed by Izolda ( Lyzolda, the Blood Witch ) as part of a ritual to arouse Rakdos , the parun of the Cult of Rakdos .

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Izolda raises Rakdos from his pit with Myc Zunich's blood; Myc briefly controls him before Izolda takes control.
timeline.quote: Izolda was able to finish the ritual and took control over Rakdos herself.

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "Dissension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos kills Momir Vig, Kraj falls, Rakdos is badly damaged and Izolda is torn apart by her cultists; Rakdos falls into a coma.
timeline.quote: However, Vig was killed by Agrus Kos and Kraj fell later, during the fight.

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "Dissension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Ravnica the Guildpact is broken and the Dissension unfolds.
timeline.quote: The subsequent breaking of the Guildpact and the events of the Dissension

citation.text: "Rift Era", section "Events on Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Izolda's Rakdos cultists use Myc's blood to awaken Rakdos; his parents interrupt, Myc bonds with the demon, and Rakdos rampages across Ravnica City.
timeline.quote: allowing the demon to rampage across Ravnica City.
